scope: Visual contract only; host Codex implements services and UI. Fixtures are not production economy.
entry: Teams > Mail; authenticated membership context from existing Teams flow. No redesign of access/search/create/chat.

transitions.effect: Mark read idempotently. Never claim implicitly; synchronize unread count with server.
Disable duplicate taps. Request authenticated entitlement claim with idempotency key tied to entitlement and claimant.
Update authoritative balances then run visual feedback once per confirmed claim revision.
Outcome may be unknown; reconcile server claim status before retry. Retry same idempotency key, never grant locally.
No grant. Keep message text readable.
Reflect server policy. Example proof assumes entire bundle deferred. Do not discard lives or grant coins twice.
Allow cached text; queue read acknowledgement if supported; claims disabled until reconnection and refresh.

rewardRules: Server owns eligibility, balances, expiry, capacity and membership authorization.
Use existing life-cap policy. Partial grants require per-item remaining entitlements; render authoritative remainder. Do not create an implicit life bank.
Coin and life values in screenshots (300 and 2) are fictional review fixtures, not approved economy settings.
Closing a pending modal does not cancel a server transaction. Reopen by entitlement status.
Expired and claimed are distinct, stable states. Device clock is not authoritative for expiry.
No auto-navigation to Shop, no purchase or coin cost in Mail.
accessibility: Unread uses seal plus label/count, not color only.
Modal focus trapped and restored to originating row. Android system back closes modal before leaving Mail.
Screen-reader roles and localized labels; respect reduced-motion setting; scroll lists and large text.
Do not render server message content as rich text/markup without sanitization.
notIncluded: Unity prefabs or C# runtime implementation
